messages.content: C大調音階中的第三個主要和弦是什麼？

function.name: get_third_chord
function.description: Calculate the third major chord in a given key. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

type.description: Type of the scale, either major or minor. Default is 'major'.

In C major, the chords built on each degree: I: C major, ii: D minor, iii: E minor, IV: F major, V: G major, vi: A minor, vii°: B diminished. The third major chord would be the chord built on the third degree? But they say "third major chord". Usually we refer to diatonic triads: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. So maybe they want the third major chord in the scale, i.e., the third chord that is major. In C major, the major chords are I (C major), IV (F major), V (G major). The third major chord would be V (G major). But the phrase "第三個主要和弦" could also be interpreted as "the third chord in the scale that is major", which indeed is G major.
